# Practice learning-action bindings

Practice owns v2 task instances, execution, submissions, evaluation, and results. Student owns a small, separate lifecycle on the existing `student_learning_action` aggregate so Practice can reserve a Student action before provisioning. This never creates a `student_task_answer`, legacy practice runtime row, mastery observation, or `learning_action.closed` outbox event.

`PRACTICE_TASK_INTERNAL_TOKEN` is required, non-empty, and must differ from the general, Planner, and Teacher inbound tokens. These routes are absent when no dedicated Practice action handler is composed; the general internal token is not accepted.

## Strict internal routes

- `PUT /internal/v2/students/{studentID}/practice-learning-actions/{taskInstanceID}` accepts `student-practice-learning-action-reserve.v1`. `Idempotency-Key` must exactly equal the URL task instance UUID. The body has the immutable task revision UUID, `sha256:` revision digest, `practice|project` surface, 1–100 unique versioned targets, and optional selected learning path UUID. `learning_action_id` is optional: when supplied, Student validates and preserves the canonical UUID; when omitted, Student generates it for backward compatibility.
- `GET` on the same URL returns `student-practice-learning-action-binding.v1`; missing and foreign bindings are both `404`.
- `POST .../open` accepts exactly `student-practice-learning-action-open.v1` and the allocated `learning_action_id`.
- `POST .../cancel` accepts exactly `student-practice-learning-action-cancel.v1` and the allocated ID. `practice_provisioning_failed` cancels only a `RESERVED` binding; `student_cancelled` cancels a `RESERVED` or `OPEN` binding. Replaying the same reason is stable; a different reason for an already-cancelled binding conflicts.
- `POST .../evidence` accepts `practice-task-competency-evidence.v2` only through the same dedicated token. `Idempotency-Key` must exactly equal canonical `evidence_id`/`submission_id`; it binds the Student-issued `learning_action_id`, exact instance/revision/revision digest, lowercase workspace digest, bounded assistance facts, and ordered public target evidence with bounded step IDs. It rejects raw validation, code, snapshots, errors, fixtures, rubrics, and solutions.

Bodies reject unknown fields/trailing data and are capped at 32 KiB. The reserve receipt hash covers the normalized URL student/instance and full normalized body. An exact replay returns the original binding; different student or payload for the same task instance conflicts.

## Lifecycle and path safety

Student allocates the action UUID. A reservation is `RESERVED` with no timestamps. For `practice`, the action context is `practice_task`; for `project`, it is `project`; both use the task instance UUID as context ID.

An optional path selector is accepted only for the owned, ACTIVE, selected path whose exact `practice` item references the revision and has the same target identity set. The item must be `READY` or `PLANNED`, all preceding items must be `COMPLETED` or `SKIPPED_MASTERED`, and no other item may be `IN_PROGRESS`. This permits the next required Practice after completion without a separate promotion command. Student stores only the path ID/version/position snapshot — never a foreign-key reference to mutable path items.

Opening rechecks that snapshot and progression eligibility, atomically moves `RESERVED -> OPEN`, sets server `opened_at`, moves the exact eligible item to `IN_PROGRESS` with `practice_started`, increments both path and journey versions once, and records a full path revision. NBA is a derived recommendation; reserve/open revalidate current state and never accept it as a capability token. An OPEN replay is stable. Cancelling a reservation changes no path. Cancelling an open path action accepts an ACTIVE or PAUSED path only when its exact frozen item remains `IN_PROGRESS`: an ACTIVE path restores `READY` only when no other item is ready, otherwise it becomes `PLANNED`; a PAUSED path becomes `PLANNED`. It records one path/journey revision. Cancellation preserves the binding's original target and path reservation and never creates evidence or mastery updates.

The cancel-reason state rules are enforced in the use case, transaction, and database constraint. Migration 029 is `NOT VALID` so historical bindings written under the former permissive provisioning-cancel behavior remain readable; every new or updated row must satisfy the current reason/state rules. The legacy practice runtime writer routes remain disabled by default and return `410 Gone`.

Evidence v2 accepts only an OPEN binding whose Student/action/instance/revision/digest and ordered target sequence match exactly. In one transaction it writes an immutable receipt correlated by the real learning-action ID, updates the shared mastery projection and audit, closes the action as passed application evidence, and completes the exact frozen `IN_PROGRESS` path item when present. Exact committed replay is stable and does not increment mastery, path, or journey state again. It never emits the legacy Course `learning_action.closed` outbox event.

Planner reconciliation rejects every content replan/NO_GAP while the matching binding is reserved. While it is open, it rejects removal, position drift, target drift, or status regression of the exact frozen Practice item and NO_GAP; a replan may only preserve the binding and the Student-owned `IN_PROGRESS` state.
